members_view.def:
SELECT id,
    department_id,
    name,
        CASE
            WHEN is_leader() THEN role
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS role,
        CASE
            WHEN is_leader() THEN access
            ELSE NULL::text[]
        END AS access,
        CASE
            WHEN is_leader() THEN status
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS status,
    phone,
    joined,
        CASE
            WHEN is_leader() THEN participation
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS participation,
    created_at,
    email,
    mentor_id
   FROM members
  WHERE department_id = my_department_id();

is_dept_admin().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_dept_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.members
    where lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and members.status in ('Active','Probationary')
      and members.department_id = public.my_department_id()
      and members.access && array['Project Admin','Department Admin']::text[]
  );
$function$

is_leader().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_leader()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from members
    where lower(members.email) = lower(auth.email())
      and members.status in ('Active','Probationary')
      and members.department_id = public.my_department_id()
      and members.access && array['Project Admin','Department Admin','Board Member','Officer']::text[]
  );
$function$

my_department_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_department_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    -- 1) the saved active station, ONLY if it's still one of the caller's departments
    ( select mad.department_id
        from public.member_active_department mad
       where mad.email = lower(auth.email())
         and exists ( select 1 from public.members m
                       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
                         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
                         and m.department_id = mad.department_id ) ),
    -- 2) else their department, deterministically. Single-dept = byte-identical to the old body.
    ( select m.department_id
        from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
       order by m.department_id
       limit 1 )
  );
$function$

my_member_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_member_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id
  from public.members
  where lower(email) = lower(auth.email())
    and status in ('Active','Probationary')
    and department_id = public.my_department_id()
  limit 1;
$function$
